note: Open questions and information gaps. These must be answered before the related decisions can be made. Answers are left blank for the owner; this session records what is known and what is missing.

questions.question: What is the authorized price-data policy and source for opening/closing lines?
questions.known: No official NFL source publishes betting lines or closing prices; all market/price fields are blank by policy.
questions.missing: A licensed or authorized market price feed (open + close) for every originated market, plus the owner's data-rights decision.

questions.question: Where do official actual starters and snap counts come from?
questions.known: The NFL Game Book (PDF) is the official source for actual starters/participation; club depth charts are unofficial and often undated; HOU depth is image-only.
questions.missing: A scalable, authorized Game Book / snap-count feed joined to every fixture.

questions.question: How should the backup-deficiency feature be sourced (route a vs route b)?
questions.known: Route (a) per-club official depth pages verified 32/32 by a peer; HOU image-only. Route (b) snap counts require an official source that does not yet exist in the verified corpus.
questions.missing: Owner verdict on SG-C; an authorized structured HOU depth source.

questions.question: What is the sample-size floor for publishing a strategy as validated?
questions.known: Peer registers use n >= 300 out-of-sample as the validation floor; current corpora are short-sample.
questions.missing: A full multi-season official results corpus to reach the floor.

questions.question: How should the site split public analysis from private raw data?
questions.known: Architecture decision required; derived analysis is publishable, raw row-level data should be gated until terms are read.
questions.missing: Owner decision on the data-layer split.

questions.question: Where do stadium roof/surface and NWS weather facts come from?
questions.known: No official roof register or NWS overlay exists in the verified corpus; venue is captured from schedule/game-centre.
questions.missing: Official 90-minute stadium roof designations and NWS hourly grids.

questions.question: What is the venue-authority rule when the schedule page and game centre disagree?
questions.known: Found a live discrepancy: schedule page hotel link says 'NRG Stadium' for IND@HOU while the game centre Game Info says 'Reliant Stadium'.
questions.missing: Owner decision: game centre is treated as authoritative per the brief; the discrepancy is flagged for review.

questions.question: How are joint probabilities for parlays/SGP validated?
questions.known: Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence; a directly validated joint probability plus operator void/push rules are required.
questions.missing: Validated joint probability estimates and operator settlement rules.

questions.question: Where does the 136-game log map to, and is the results feed complete?
questions.known: The 136-game log equals Weeks 1-9. Week-10 finals join is partial in peer feeds; standings arithmetic reconciles to 150 games through Week 10 (verified 2026-11-19).
questions.missing: A complete, official results join through the current week.

questions.question: What is the injury-designation reliability threshold for use as a feature?
questions.known: Peers measured Out/Doubtful/Questionable play-rates with Wilson CIs from a single season's inactive join.
questions.missing: Multi-season reliability with confidence intervals before the label becomes a model feature.
